body: Founder flagged the landing page's mission/structure/get-involved copy as dismissive toward traditional charity and donation-based nonprofit models ('legacy systems... extracting', 'not just a donation request', 'not extracted from them'). Rewrote all four affected sections to explicitly frame CarePyre as infrastructure built alongside existing nonprofits, congregations, and community organizations in Pontiac -- not in opposition to them. Added a permanent Tone/Voice guardrail to STYLE_GUIDE.md. Commit b1b05b8 (contact form) -> 3b901f7 (copy fix), pushed live to /var/www/carepyre/.
title: CarePyre landing copy: removed charity-partner snark, reframed as partnership
